segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on as executive producer, identifying as the dog who produces the show and declaring no breaks for election night.

segments.title: Election Coverage — Early Returns & Network Surfing
segments.notes: Case Blackwell anchors live election night coverage, cycling through AP, CNN, NBC, CBS, RSBN, and Fox feeds while discussing early Democratic leads in Texas, South Carolina, and Kansas; Rick and Hype Train provide commentary and musical interruptions.

segments.title: Shirts vs. Skins Debate
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate the merits of shirts versus skins in pickup basketball, with Munch arguing for shirts as civilizational progress and Crum selecting skins; Munch's skeletal physiology complicates the binary.

segments.title: Election Coverage — Projections & Concession Speeches
segments.notes: Case returns to the anchor desk as NBC projects Democratic House and Senate majorities; Chet interrupts on 'science' trigger, JD Vance impression occurs, and Case monitors tightening Michigan race while watching rival streamers.

segments.title: Brandon's Election Night Speedrun
segments.notes: Brandon (CryptoZeu$) plays a platformer game with muffled maternal interventions, completes a blind speedrun on first attempt, and departs to eat glowing green fruit roll-ups found beneath floorboards.

segments.title: Election Coverage — Final Calls & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Case reviews final Senate projections (51 Democratic seats), watches concession speeches and Trump Truth Social posts, announces streaming schedule for the week, and ends broadcast with a raid.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold open sign-on as the dog who produces the show, declares no-breaks election night.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors flagship election night coverage, cycles network feeds, performs JD Vance impression, enforces no-breaks November.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: correspondent. Reads viewer reactions, trades barbs with Hype Train, claims PSYOP slot powers from CIA background.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical interruption. Derails subscriber acknowledgments into freestyle raps, declares allegiance to blue wave, promotes Piss Fruit Ninja.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: Skeleton debate analyst argues shirts represent civilizational progress, reveals failed Buzz Lightyear Halloween costume.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: Gambling-addicted debate analyst picks skins for pickup basketball tradition, claims medical exemption from shirts.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Commandeers broadcast on 'science' trigger, discusses Star Trek uniform logic and Picard's lack of shorts.

characters.name: Brandon (CryptoZeu$)
characters.notes: gaming correspondent. Plays platformer with mother yelling through door, completes blind speedrun on first attempt, eats irradiated fruit roll-ups.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News broadcasts live election night coverage as Democrats flip Senate seats in Texas, South Carolina, and Kansas while projecting House and Senate majorities. Anchor Case Blackwell cycles network feeds, contends with Munch and Crum's shirts-versus-skins debate, and monitors a tightening Michigan race. Gaming correspondent Brandon completes a speedrun between maternal interruptions, and the broadcast concludes with Case confirming a no-breaks November schedule through Saturday.
